projectToolSchema.note: Anthropic-format hosts that need the tool-schema projection; the first-party API is the only one today.

promptCache.note: Explicit breakpoints, 5m and 1h. Claude bills cache writes by the TTL written: 5m at 1.25x input (the models.dev price), 1h at 2x (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, checked 2026-11-05).

longCacheWrite.note: Models.dev lists only the short-TTL write price; the long-TTL write is this multiple of the input price.

tokenizer.note: OpenAI has not published the GPT-6 / GPT-5.6 tokenizer; o200k is the estimate.

promptCache.note: GPT-5.6+ caches automatically: `prompt_cache_options.ttl` is "30m" (default) or "12h". A long request takes the shortest option of at least 1 hour, which is 12h. Writes bill 1.25x input for 30m (the models.dev price) and 2.5x for 12h (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, checked 2026-11-05).

longCacheWrite.note: Models.dev lists only the short-TTL write price; the long-TTL write is this multiple of the input price.

thinksByDefault.note: The model thinks unless told not to; models.dev does not say.

promptCache.note: DeepSeek documents the cache as cleared "usually within a few hours to a few days". One hour is the lower bound of that and an estimate; Flow sends no cache_control and has no lifetime choice, so both chat kinds get it.

price.note: models.dev lists the off-peak rates; peak is double and Flow charges peak at all hours.

maxLinkBytes.note: Gemini fetches a link up to 15 MB.

promptCache.note: The Gemini API documents no lifetime for implicit caching, so prediction reads it as cold. Implicit cache only: no write fee.

functionCallIds.note: Gemini 3 and later put an id on each function call and let a function response hold media; the runtime used to read this from a gemini-N id. Carried over for gemini-4-argon without re-reading the source.

price.note: Google's standard rates; models.dev lists the introductory ones, which end 2026-11-30 ("$2.00 through November 30, 2026. $4.00 starting December 1, 2026").
